# ================================================================
#  Burden of Infrastructure - 1836 world seed   (GENERATED FILE)
#
#  DO NOT HAND-EDIT. See tools/REGENERATE.md.
#
#  WHY HISTORY AND NOT A SCRIPTED EFFECT: buildings created during
#  world initialization start STAFFED. on_game_started fires after
#  init, by which point pops are already allocated, so anything
#  created there starts with zero employees and hires over several
#  weeks. create_building has no employment parameter and the game
#  has no employment effect, so history is the only way.
#
#  Horse Ranches go to the primary owner only: 218 of the 675
#  owned state regions are split, and rural land is shared.
#  Public Works and Harbour Works follow each actual state owner
#  in infrastructure_seed_plan.tsv, including split regions.
#
#  HORSE RANCHES ARE CURATED - and this is the important part.
#  A state's REAL arable land depends on incorporation status and
#  province ownership, neither of which can be read statically.
#  Seeding by the state region's declared arable_land over-
#  allocated 10 states (STATE_BALUCHISTAN declares 63; the Omani
#  state actually had 1) and produced:
#      "State X is using an excess of N arable land"
#  immediately before a hard crash during world init.
#
#  The baseline curated ranches are restricted to states that are:
#    CORE          owner's primary culture is a homeland culture
#                  of the state (proxy for incorporated)
#    SOLE OWNER    region not split between countries
#    LOW INDUSTRY  vanilla seeds <= 1 industrial building there
#    ARABLE >= 25  declared by the state region
#  All 10 previously failing states are excluded by these gates.
#  Incorporated baseline levels scale with declared arable land:
#  4 below 50, 6 from 50 to 99, and 8 at 100 or above. Fifteen
#  baseline states are explicitly unincorporated in game history;
#  their previously safe 3 levels are a cap (horse_seed_holds.tsv).
#  Fourteen new core, sole-owner, incorporated states with safe
#  land headroom are listed in horse_seed_additions.tsv.
#  Lower 1836 levels follow horse_seed_reductions.tsv. Zero removes
#  a ranch; reductions favor less suitable breeding regions.
#
#  Public Works and Harbour Works are NOT rural and cost no
#  arable land. Starting levels replace vanilla port and rail
#  infrastructure with minimal unavoidable rounding surplus.
#
#  Only the base method PM is forced. Administration PMs are left
#  unset so the engine resolves them from each country's
#  Bureaucracy law.
# ================================================================
